api_notes: Deviations from brief (stronger): Processor::process takes &CancellationToken and returns Result; Processor::accepts/required_sample_rate_hz/max_frames/reset added; Engine owns resource + live revision (RequestContext has no current_revision) so a revision bump mid-block discards the block; BlockReceipt is Copy with labels()/peak() slices; HardLimiter::new(rate, channels, HardLimiterParams). Spec declares no Mono/5.1 labels (UNVERIFIED) so ChannelLayout::mono(label) takes the label. Send type is named SendRoute (std Send would be shadowed).
limitations: ClipResampler alignment: rubato trims floor(256*ratio/2) output frames; measured residual lead 0.4..1.02 output frames across 48k->44.1k, 48k->48k, 48k->96k, 44.1k->48k (test bound 1.6). Exact alignment would need the rubato Fft resampler (default feature; adds realfft/rustfft) or an own calibrated trim.
Equalizer shapes follow the W3C Audio EQ Cookbook; Adobe curve parity and spec flags constant_q/low2ndorder/high2ndorder/ultraquiet are not mapped (spec declares no semantics).
Cancel inside Engine::resample is polled only at admission and at the publication gate (rubato process_all is one call; bounded by MAX_BLOCK_FRAMES).
